newsitem.title: UK: South West Water new facility to aid profit.
newsitem.headline: South West Water new facility to aid profit.

text.p: UK utility South West Water Plc said on Thursday it concluded an additional leasing facility totalling 180 million stg that will help boost its profits.

In a statement, the company said that 45 million stg had been drawn down from the additional facility which produced a pretax profit of six million stg to be included in half year results to September 30.
South West Water said it expected further drawdowns to increase to nine million stg the pretax profit improvements to be reflected in the 1996/97 full year results.
"Comparable levels of pretax profit should result in each of the following two years as the facility is fully utilised by September 30, 1999," the company added.
South West Water said the facility was in addition to finance leasing facilities in place totalling 300 million stg, for which 150 million stg was provided as collateral in 1995.
These leases mainly relate to plant and equipment of the water and sewerage business and cover the economic life of the assets.
The new facility provides further capacity for similar types of assets, South West Water said.
"They are managing to squeeze out a bit more on profits," said one analyst who asked not to be identified.
Analysts said pretax profit forecasts for the full year might now look cautious.
